name: Shiyi Ouxiang Chudao Zhong
source:
These characters already had a bad ending, but with your help they may rewrite their destiny! 

You just became the producer of an idol band whose members all suffer from amnesia. As you become entangled with them, will you be able to give them a happy ending?
translation:
这些角色已经迎来过糟糕的结局，但在你的帮助下，他们或许能改写命运！

你刚刚成为一支偶像乐队的制作人，而成员们全都患有失忆症。当你与他们纠缠在一起时，能否为他们带来幸福结局？
